definitions.explanation: A punitive measure imposed on a person, organization, or nation for violating rules, laws, or norms.

examples.japanese: {経済|けいざい}{制裁|せいさい}を{科|か}す。
{違反者|いはんしゃ}には{厳|きび}しい{制裁|せいさい}が{待|ま}っている。
{国連|こくれん}は{全会一致|ぜんかいいっち}で{制裁|せいさい}{決議|けつぎ}を{採択|さいたく}した。
examples.english: The United Nations unanimously adopted a sanctions resolution.

notes:
Most commonly encountered in political and international contexts, especially regarding {経済|けいざい}{制裁|せいさい} (economic sanctions). Also used in organizational and social contexts for disciplinary measures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{経済|けいざい}{制裁|せいさい} (economic sanctions)
・{制裁|せいさい}を{科|か}す (impose sanctions)
・{制裁|せいさい}を{加|くわ}える (inflict punishment)
・{制裁|せいさい}{措置|そち} (punitive measures)
・{制裁|せいさい}{決議|けつぎ} (sanctions resolution)
